name: lightningocr
title: LightningOCR
description: Permanently-warm OCR engine for Raycast. Converts clipboard images and screenshots containing text and math into clean Markdown with LaTeX.
author: lightningocr

commands.name: ocr-clipboard
commands.title: OCR Clipboard Image
commands.subtitle: LightningOCR
commands.description: Reads the image currently in your clipboard and converts it to Markdown. Mathematical formulas are automatically converted to LaTeX.

commands.name: ocr-file
commands.title: OCR Image File
commands.subtitle: LightningOCR
commands.description: Select an image file and convert it to Markdown with LaTeX math.

preferences.name: quality
preferences.title: OCR Quality
preferences.description: Controls the trade-off between speed and accuracy. 'Balanced' is recommended for most use cases.

preferences.name: preloadFormula
preferences.title: Preload Formula Model
preferences.description: Load the math recognition model at daemon startup instead of on first use. Increases startup time but eliminates the first-formula delay.
preferences.label: Preload formula model at startup

preferences.name: showConfidence
preferences.title: Show Confidence Score
preferences.description: Display the OCR confidence score in the result preview.
preferences.label: Show confidence score

preferences.name: cacheEnabled
preferences.title: Enable Result Cache
preferences.description: Cache OCR results by image hash. Identical screenshots are returned instantly.
preferences.label: Cache results

preferences.name: socketPath
preferences.title: Daemon Socket Path
preferences.description: Unix domain socket path for the LightningOCR daemon.
